one_liner: Close is a sales CRM with built-in calling, email, SMS, and AI agents.

auth.notes: API keys for scripts or OAuth 2.0 for user-facing integrations. Both methods support API and MCP server access.

evidence.snippet: API keys for scripts or OAuth 2.0 for user-facing integrations.
An API key is a secret token (like a password) which you can use to connect Close data

access.notes: 14-day free trial available without approval or sales contact. Developers can immediately create API keys during trial. Continued use requires paid plan.

evidence.snippet: To create a new API key, go to Settings > Developer > API Keys and click + New API Key

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Essentials plan and above offer no daily API quota or per-request fees. Solo plan rate limits not explicitly documented.

evidence.snippet: REST API Reference Full endpoint docs with schemas, examples, and an interactive API explorer.
Webhooks & Events Real-time event notifications and a 30-day event log.
No daily API request quota or per-request fees.
The MCP server URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp and has “HTTP Streamable” and “OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)” support.
Close's MCP server is officially supported across the Claude ecosystem.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free trial, public REST API with webhooks, official MCP server, and Composio toolkit with 75 tools already published.

overview_evidence.snippet: Close CRM | The CRM That Does the Work
